description: Golden set for the live copilot (run_copilot). Each case lists the expected plan (tools or sub-agents, in order), the facts the answer must contain, and where each fact was verified. Facts were checked against Firestore project self-improving-ai-513915 on 2026-11-17 (crm_settings data_as_of 2026-10-27, holdings_as_of 2026-10-24). Cases G01 to G20 are the dev split (the learner may learn from them); V01 to V20 reword them and are the holdout split (used only to accept or reject a change). Cases H01 to H10 (dev) and W01 to W10 (holdout) are harder: comparisons and totals across clients, date windows, two-step chains, partly unknown clients and conditional trade requests. They were checked on 2026-11-20; holdout variants often use different clients so a lesson cannot just memorize an answer.
